blocks.content: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) launched e-Inspection and e-Certified Copy services on 12 August 2026 to provide electronic access to judicial records and certified copies. The services were inaugurated by NCLT President Justice Anupinder Singh Grewal through a video conferencing ceremony.

items: The National Company Law Tribunal was constituted under the Companies Act, 2013.
The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 created a time-bound framework for insolvency resolution in India.
e-Courts 2.0 is a digital initiative for technology-enabled court services in India.
Special Benches are formed by tribunals and courts to handle specific categories of cases or workload pressures.
